'''Powered weights''' were high-tech equipment used by individuals to exercise. The [[Imperial Aquatic Garrison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]] had powered weights in its training and recreation center.<ref name="BGS">''[[Battle for the Golden Sun]]''</ref>
